title: Atlanta Braves Baseball Game Ticket at Truist Park
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children ages two and under may be admitted to Braves games without a ticket. However, they must sit in the lap of an accompanying adult.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
While visiting Atlanta, catching an Atlanta Braves baseball game at Truist Park offers an unforgettable blend of American tradition, Southern hospitality, and world-class entertainment.
Home to one of the most historic and successful franchises, Truist Park delivers a lively, family-friendly atmosphere that appeals to visitors of all backgrounds. Located in the vibrant Battery Atlanta entertainment district, the ballpark is surrounded by restaurants, shops, and live music venues — making it an all-in-one destination for an exciting day or night out.
Perfect for solo travelers, couples, families, and groups, an Atlanta Braves game offers more than just America’s pastime — it’s a taste of Atlanta’s vibrant identity and a must-do event for any visitor.
